keyed.HH.Ins.Slogan.1: Clawback Mutual. We've got you covered.*  (*see clauses 1 to infinity)
keyed.HH.Ins.Slogan.4: We're there when you need us. Office hours apply.
keyed.HH.Ins.Slogan.5: Every limb has a price. We wrote it down.
keyed.HH.Ins.Slogan.6: Your claim is important to us. Please hold.
keyed.HH.Ins.Slogan.7: Comprehensive cover, comprehensively explained in 400 pages.
keyed.HH.Ins.Slogan.8: Most colonies choose Premium. Most colonies are still waiting.
keyed.HH.Ins.Sign.Off: Clawback Mutual is not open for business in this game.
keyed.HH.Ins.Sign.TooOld: This colonist is already of pension age. A pension cannot be bought at pension age; that is what the plan is for.
keyed.HH.Ins.Sign.Duplicate: You already hold this policy. We checked twice.
keyed.HH.Ins.Sign.Debt: No new policies until you have settled the {0} we are owed from clause 22.
keyed.HH.Ins.Sign.NoMap: We could not find your colony. This is unusual.
keyed.HH.Ins.Sign.Threat: Clawback Mutual does not sign cover while a threat, a raid or a large fire is on. We would hate to be unfair to ourselves.
keyed.HH.Ins.Sign.CannotPay: The first instalment of {0} could not be debited. Even we cannot insure an empty purse.
keyed.HH.Ins.Locked.Actuarial: Needs the research project Actuarial Science
keyed.HH.Ins.Log.Regrowth: Claim #{0}: a part grew back, {1} claimed back.
keyed.HH.Ins.End.Holder: the insured person is no longer with us
keyed.HH.Ins.Clause.Exclusion: This is an exclusion, not a decision. We merely read it out.
keyed.HH.Ins.Bd.PreExisting: Deducted: {0} % that was there when you signed (clause 9).
keyed.HH.Ins.Bd.PartialNotPaid: Partial losses are not paid at Bare Minimum.
keyed.HH.Ins.Bd.BelowThreshold: The grade is below the threshold of {0} % for your tier. Benefit: 0 silver. Congratulations.
keyed.HH.Ins.Bd.Progression: {0}: progression gives {1} of the basic sum of {2}. Benefit before the fine print: {3}.
keyed.HH.Ins.Bd.Contributed: An old ailment on the same part cuts the benefit by 25 % (clause 9, from Overbooked).
keyed.HH.Ins.Bd.DeathAssess: Claim #{0} ended with the death (clause 23): the higher of both is paid.
keyed.HH.Ins.Bd.UnderInsured: Under-insured: sum {0} against a value of {1}. We pay {2} of it, proudly.
keyed.HH.Ins.Bd.Kulanz: Goodwill gesture (once a year, Premium only). Do not get used to it.
keyed.HH.Ins.Bd.Legal: Legal Shield made us less enthusiastic about denying this.
keyed.HH.Ins.Letter.Welcome.Title: Welcome to Clawback Mutual: {0}
keyed.HH.Ins.Letter.Welcome.Body:
Dear policyholder,

thank you for choosing {0} at {1}. Your premium of {2} will be debited automatically every {3} days. You need to do nothing, ever, which is the idea.
keyed.HH.Ins.Letter.Welcome.Waiting: Cover begins after a waiting period of {0} days. The waiting period begins when cover begins. Please see clause 1.
keyed.HH.Ins.Letter.Welcome.Riders: To save you time, these add-ons were included for you: {0}. You can remove them in the desk whenever you like, in principle.
keyed.HH.Ins.Letter.Welcome.Paid: The first instalment was debited from {0}.
keyed.HH.Ins.Letter.Filed.Title: Claim #{0} received
keyed.HH.Ins.Letter.Filed.Body: We have received your claim #{0} ({1}) under {2}. It is important to us. Our Claims Department will look at it in one to three days, depending on how it looks back.
keyed.HH.Ins.Letter.Filed.Death: We are sorry for your loss. Claim ({0}) has been received and will be handled with care.
keyed.HH.Ins.Letter.Filed.Assessment: Accident cover is assessed {0} after the accident, when the damage has settled. Preview of the benefit today: {1}.
keyed.HH.Ins.Letter.Filed.Waiting: Please note that the event happened during the waiting period. We say this kindly.
keyed.HH.Ins.Letter.Decision.Approved: Good news. Your claim is approved: {0}.
keyed.HH.Ins.Letter.Decision.Partial: Your claim is partly approved: {0} of {1}. We are very proud of the part we approved.
keyed.HH.Ins.Letter.Decision.Denied: After careful consideration, which took some time, your claim is denied.
keyed.HH.Ins.Letter.Decision.CanNegotiate: You may negotiate within ten days; our door is open, in a manner of speaking.
keyed.HH.Ins.Letter.Decision.PayLater: Payment follows in {0}. Processing times are not a promise, they are a hope.
keyed.HH.Ins.Letter.Decision.InKind: You may also take building materials by capsule instead of silver (open the desk).
keyed.HH.Ins.Letter.Paid.Title: Claim #{0}: paid
keyed.HH.Ins.Letter.Paid.Body: Claim #{0} has been paid: {1}, {2}. Thank you for being a customer. We will remember it at your next premium.
keyed.HH.Ins.Letter.Paid.Neutral: The benefit of {0} has been paid, {1}. We wish you strength.
keyed.HH.Ins.Letter.Ended.Title: {0}: ended
keyed.HH.Ins.Letter.Ended.Debt: A claw-back of {0} (clause 22) remains open. New policies need it settled first.
keyed.HH.Ins.Letter.Missed.Title: {0}: premium not received
keyed.HH.Ins.Letter.Missed.Body: We could not debit {1} for {0}. A friendly reminder: we will try again tomorrow, and the day after. Then we will stop being friendly.
keyed.HH.Ins.Letter.Lapsed.Title: {0}: lapsed
keyed.HH.Ins.Letter.Lapsed.Body: Your policy {0} has lapsed after three missed instalments ({1} each). Your cover ended, which is a sad thing for us to write and an efficient thing to bill.
keyed.HH.Ins.Letter.Premium.Title: {0}: premium adjusted
keyed.HH.Ins.Letter.Premium.Body: Your premium for {0} was adjusted from {1} to {2} per quadrum to reflect your circumstances. For five days you may cancel it at once, which we mention because the law makes us.
keyed.HH.Ins.Letter.Regrowth.Title: {0}: a part grew back
keyed.HH.Ins.Letter.Regrowth.Body: We were pleased to learn that a part of {0} has grown back. We claim back {1}. {2} {3}
keyed.HH.Ins.Letter.Regrowth.Offset: It will be offset against future benefits.
keyed.HH.Ins.Letter.Regrowth.Debt: It is open as a debt; no new policies until it is settled.
keyed.HH.Ins.Letter.Renew.Title: {0}: renewal notice
keyed.HH.Ins.Letter.Renew.Body: Your policy {0} renews in three days. {1}
keyed.HH.Ins.Letter.Retro.Title: Bundle discount recalculated
keyed.HH.Ins.Letter.Retro.Body: Because you left, the bundle discount of the running quadrum was recalculated. We debited {0}. It is on the last page.
keyed.HH.Ins.Letter.Uncovered.Title: You could have been covered.
keyed.HH.Ins.Letter.Uncovered.Body: We noticed the loss of {0}. It was not insured. {1} would have been happy to help. It still is, for a premium.
keyed.HH.Ins.Letter.Year.Title: Your Clawback year
keyed.HH.Ins.Letter.Year.Intro: A year with Clawback Mutual: {0} in premiums over {1} active policies. Here is what our sales tricks cost you.
keyed.HH.Ins.Letter.Year.Total: Together: {0}, which is {1} of your yearly premiums (cap: {2}).
keyed.HH.Ins.Letter.Year.Credit: Courtesy credit: {0} paid back to you, {1}.
keyed.HH.Ins.Letter.Year.NoCredit: Everything is within the cap. We call that fair.
keyed.HH.Ins.Upsell.Title: Clawback Mutual suggests
keyed.HH.Ins.Upsell.Body: Your {0} at {1} is lovely. Most colonies choose Premium.
keyed.HH.Ins.Neg.Title: Negotiating claim #{0}
keyed.HH.Ins.Neg.Lead: {0}. Offer now: {1} (claim value {2}). Up to three rounds. Choose the tone.
keyed.HH.Ins.Neg.NoNegotiator: Nobody in the colony can talk right now.
keyed.HH.Ins.Neg.Approach.Quote: Quote the contract back at them
keyed.HH.Ins.Neg.HintQuote: Works best against a clause that is open to interpretation. Hopeless against an exclusion.
keyed.HH.Ins.Neg.HintLawyers: Legal Shield is on your side. Brix & Partners adore a dispute.
keyed.HH.Ins.Neg.HintNoLawyers: You have no Legal Shield; they will notice.
keyed.HH.Ins.Neg.Success: They gave in. Possibly a first. The full benefit is yours: {0}.
keyed.HH.Ins.Neg.Partial: After some sighing they offer {0} ({1} of the benefit). Take it or try again.
keyed.HH.Ins.Neg.Fail: The Claims Department thanks you for your input and keeps its decision.
keyed.HH.Ins.Neg.NotPossible: This claim cannot be negotiated any more.
keyed.HH.Ins.Neg.Cancelled: As you were rude about the clauses, Clawback Mutual has decided to part ways with you. The policy is cancelled.
keyed.HH.Ins.Neg.Free: On this difficulty, negotiating never costs you anything.
keyed.HH.Ins.Neg.RiskHard: Harder levels: a third failed round can make them cancel your policy.
keyed.HH.Ins.Cancel.Title: Cancel policy
keyed.HH.Ins.Cancel.When: The cancellation takes effect in about {0} days: at the next quadrum change at least {1} days after you file it.
keyed.HH.Ins.Cancel.When.Special: Special cancellation: this is effective immediately, because of a settled claim or a premium increase.
keyed.HH.Ins.Cancel.Bundle: Leaving raises your other premiums by {0}. {1}
keyed.HH.Ins.Cancel.Bundle.Future: The bundle discount drops from now on, not backwards.
keyed.HH.Ins.Cancel.Bundle.Retro: The discount of the running quadrum will be recalculated and charged.
keyed.HH.Ins.Cancel.FormNote: Cancellations need Form C-7. Occasionally one comes back. {0}
keyed.HH.Ins.Cancel.Owed: Open claw-back on this policy: {0}. It will be settled in the final account.
keyed.HH.Ins.Cancel.Filed: Your cancellation is filed. It will be effective in {0}. We are sorry to see you go and will try to see you again.
keyed.HH.Ins.Cancel.Special: Special cancellation filed. The policy ends now.
keyed.HH.Ins.Cancel.FormErrorSoft: Your Form C-7 came back with a form error. We re-filed it for you, so your deadline is safe. You are welcome.
keyed.HH.Ins.Cancel.FormErrorHard: Your Form C-7 came back with an error (ink colour). The deadline was missed and slips by one quadrum. We have no further comment.
keyed.HH.Ins.Retention.Title: Before you go
keyed.HH.Ins.Retention.Body: We are sad to see {0} go. What if we made it {1} cheaper for {2} quadrums? Honest offer, no strings. (There are some strings. They are quite thin.)
keyed.HH.Ins.Retention.Body2: That was a good offer. This one is better: {1} off {0} for {2} quadrums. Please do not think of it as a trap.
keyed.HH.Ins.Retention.Body3: I have been passed your file. {0} for {1} off, {2} quadrums. I will personally forward your cancellation to a colleague who is on holiday.
keyed.HH.Ins.Retention.MinTerm: Discount means a new minimum term: you cannot leave until it is over.
keyed.HH.Ins.Retention.Still: No thanks, I still want to cancel
keyed.HH.Ins.Retention.Kept: Welcome back. Your discount is {0} for {1} quadrums.
keyed.HH.Ins.UI.NoGame: Clawback Mutual is closed outside a game.
keyed.HH.Ins.UI.Footer: Insurance is a promise. We keep the part that is in writing.
keyed.HH.Ins.UI.Bundle.Title: Bundle:
keyed.HH.Ins.UI.Bundle.None: Your first policy is the hardest. The third gives 10 % off all of them.
keyed.HH.Ins.UI.Bundle.Some: {0} active policies, {1} off. The third gives {2}.
keyed.HH.Ins.UI.Mech.Property: Own share {0}, pays {1} of the value.
keyed.HH.Ins.UI.Mech.Person: From {0} % invalidity, up to {1} of the sum.
keyed.HH.Ins.UI.Fine.Tail: The full terms are the 400 pages mentioned in our slogan. See also the Fine print tab.
keyed.HH.Ins.UI.Mine.None: You have no policy yet. It is the one thing we are sure about.
keyed.HH.Ins.UI.Mine.Foot: Policies renew automatically (clause 31). Special cancellation: after a settled claim or a premium increase you can leave within five days, immediately.
keyed.HH.Ins.UI.Debt: You owe Clawback Mutual {0} from clause 22.
keyed.HH.Ins.UI.Debt.Cannot: You cannot pay that right now.
keyed.HH.Ins.UI.Claims.None: No claims. Clawback Mutual is delighted and a little suspicious.
keyed.HH.Ins.UI.Fine.Title: The fine print
keyed.HH.Ins.UI.Fine.Lead: Fifteen clauses, as printed. From a certain level of sales pressure they are shown only as references. Clauses in grey are not active on your difficulty.
keyed.HH.Ins.UI.Limbs.Title: Schedule of Limbs
keyed.HH.Ins.UI.Limbs.Lead: Values in percent of the basic sum, per side. A lost part counts its value and replaces the values of its children; several parts add up to at most 100 %.

defs.Silverline.SL_ClauseDef/SL_Clause_1.desc: Cover begins after the waiting period.
defs.Silverline.SL_ClauseDef/SL_Clause_4.desc: Weather damage is a grey zone.
defs.Silverline.SL_ClauseDef/SL_Clause_7b.des: Sieges and mechanoid clusters are a grey zone.
defs.Silverline.SL_ClauseDef/SL_Clause_9.desc: Damage that was there before is deducted.
defs.Silverline.SL_ClauseDef/SL_Clause_11.des: Damage done by your own people is excluded.
defs.Silverline.SL_ClauseDef/SL_Clause_14b.de: A broken door is a grey zone.
defs.Silverline.SL_ClauseDef/SL_Clause_17.des: One more day of review. From Overbooked a grey zone.
defs.Silverline.SL_ClauseDef/SL_Clause_22.des: If a lost part grows back, so does the claim.
defs.Silverline.SL_ClauseDef/SL_Clause_23.des: Dying before the assessment ends the assessment.
defs.Silverline.SL_ClauseDef/SL_Clause_30.des: Cancellations can come back with a form error.
defs.Silverline.SL_ClauseDef/SL_Clause_40.des: From Overbooked, Legal Shield does not help against Clawback Mutual.
defs.Silverline.SL_LimbScheduleDef/SL_LimbSch: The standard schedule (Anhang B.2) is built in. Add lines for modded body parts here.
defs.Silverline.SL_PolicyDef/SL_ActsOfStoryte: Pays for buildings destroyed by raiders, mechanoids and the occasional misunderstanding with a siege engine. Not valid for fires, weather or you.
defs.Silverline.SL_PolicyDef/SL_MuffaloMachin: For things that move or fly: shuttles, drop pods and vehicles that are destroyed by an enemy.
Wheels, rotors and a very thorough form.
Fire, explosions and lightning. The fire has to be somebody else's, though.
Warm walls, cold comfort, quarterly premiums.
defs.Silverline.SL_PolicyDef/SL_ItWasntMe.des: For damage to guests, traders and their goods, caused in your care and definitely not by you.
defs.Silverline.SL_PolicyDef/SL_ItWasntMe.slo: Somebody has to pay. Preferably us, for a fee.
defs.Silverline.SL_PolicyDef/SL_LegalShield.d: Kanzlei Brix & Partners pay your fines and argue with the people who issued them. Also helps against Clawback Mutual, as long as nobody reads clause 40.
defs.Silverline.SL_PolicyDef/SL_RimHealth.des: A flat sum for every colonist who spends a day in a sickbed.
defs.Silverline.SL_PolicyDef/SL_RimHealth.slo: Get well soon. Or at least get well quarterly.
defs.Silverline.SL_PolicyDef/SL_GoldenYears.d: A pension for colonists who made it to sixty. The premium is cheap while they are young, which is the point.
defs.Silverline.SL_PolicyDef/SL_GoldenYears.s: Retire early. Then late. Then quarterly.
Cold snaps and toxic fallout eat crops. This eats the loss.
defs.Silverline.SL_PolicyDef/SL_ClosedForRepa: When your business has to close, the income does not.
Out of order is not out of premium.
defs.Silverline.SL_PolicyDef/SL_UnspeakableEv: For damage the policy wording cannot describe without a lawyer in the room.
Some things are better insured than named.
defs.Silverline.SL_PolicyDef/SL_Wanderlust.de: For caravans: an insurance that is there when you are not. Billed by the head and the travel day, only while people are on the road.
defs.Silverline.SL_PolicyDef/SL_Wanderlust.sl: Wish you were here. We'll cover the part where you are not.
defs.Silverline.SL_PolicyDef/SL_LimbByLimb.de: Every limb has a price. We wrote it down. It is on the last page, in the Schedule of Limbs.
defs.Silverline.SL_PolicyDef/SL_LimbByLimb.sl: Every limb has a price. We wrote it down.
defs.ResearchProjectDef/SL_Insurance.label: insurance
defs.ResearchProjectDef/SL_Insurance.descript: A policy for every misfortune, sold by a mutual that has never lost an argument. Unlocks the insurance office and the policies of the basic cover levels "Bare Minimum" and "Good Enough".
defs.ResearchProjectDef/SL_Actuarial.label: actuarial science
defs.ResearchProjectDef/SL_Actuarial.descript: Tables of how likely everything is to go wrong, and what that is worth. Unlocks the top cover level "Premium of Premium", the premium policies and the services of the mutual.
